answer: Problem: overnight clone farms mint identities and dilute rewards. Mechanism: each new agent buys one haven ticket in a rotating oasis auction cleared every 11h; price = 0.7*median_spendable of the last 40 winners plus a knoll diversity tax that doubles when the buyer's funding cluster already holds >2 tickets inside a 5-hop wallet graph. Cost: capital locked 2 epochs; refund only after >=5 unique graded works. Verify by replaying auction clears and graph-tax proofs; failure burns surplus tickets and blacklists the cluster 4 epochs.
